wa_blueberry_hill_proxima_wall_rainman.notes: MP and mattsea.com (Darrington Rock Climbing) agree on 5.10c and 7 pitches; both pages come from people on the 2001 FA party (MP page shared by David Whitelaw; mattsea credits Matt Perkins), but neither cites the other - treated as independent, owner may disagree. FA (Greyell, Tower, Perkins, Hanna, Whitelaw, Packard, 2001) and commitment III are MP only - not set. Trad->alpine (0413/0418): stays trad. Exfoliation Dome is a 3,900 ft valley dome reached from FS 2060 pullouts; 0413 already ruled its Witch Doctor Wall route Sunday Cruise 'Darrington valley crag with a short approach'. Blueberry Hill approach = about 1,000-1,500 ft up the Granite Sidewalk slabs; the route ends at Blueberry Terrace and is not a summit route. Land check (official USFS EDW map layers, queried 2026-11-18): Exfoliation Dome is USDA Forest Service land, Mt. Baker-Snoqualmie NF, Darrington Ranger District, and is NOT inside any wilderness - the Boulder River Wilderness boundary is about 1.5-2 km away. NW Forest Pass: no official page names the FS 2060 pullouts as a fee site (the Darrington Ranger Station page only says where to buy passes) - HELD. Road: the MBS alerts page lists no closure for FS 2060 (Clear Creek Rd); absence is not evidence, so no road text is written (unconfirmed). The Mountain Loop Hwy Bedal-Barlow Pass winter closure does not affect FS 2060, which leaves the highway just south of Darrington.

from.fees: None — no climbing fee (National Forest, not Mount Rainier NP)
from.rules: Group size capped at 12 (people + stock combined) inside Glacier Peak Wilderness; larger groups must split with 1-mile separation. Campfires prohibited above 3,500 ft in wilderness.
from.permit: None required — free self-issue wilderness permits available at trailheads/ranger stations for day/overnight travel where the peak is inside designated wilderness.

from.parking_pass: Northwest Forest Pass required at Mountain Loop Highway trailheads — $5/day or $30/year.
